reserveReview.rationale: The single-asset GHO wrapper was re-confirmed at Ethereum block 26098749: asset() is canonical GHO, and its GHO balance exactly equals totalAssets(). The deployed implementation has deposit/withdrawal accounting and no borrowing or external lending strategy; underlying-token rescue is limited to balance minus accounted assets and maxRescue(GHO) is zero. The vault owner is Umbrella 0xd400fc38ed4732893174325693a63c30ee3881a8, whose GHO slashing configuration covers the Ethereum Core Pool only. Staked principal is loss-absorption capital: automated deficit slashing can reduce redeemable value. The 100% slice describes underlying identity, not absence of loss risk.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Standing single-asset ERC-4626 wrapper structure, confirmed by pinned asset() at Ethereum block 26095800
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The wrapper's GHO identity is verified; GHO's own backing and controls remain parent exposure. Future deficits can reduce redeemable assets through automated slashing.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: At Ethereum block 26098749, accounted GHO principal is held in the staking vault, with no deployed borrowing or external lending path and no rescuable GHO excess. This is fully on-chain custody, while legal segregation and insolvency treatment remain unestablished. Capital reuse is specifically GHO-deficit loss absorption through Umbrella slashing, rather than an unidentified rehypothecation strategy. Governance can upgrade the proxy and change pause, cooldown and slashing configuration, so current executable restrictions do not establish a permanent legal prohibition on reuse.
